_note: AUD-01. Sound IDs are the IDs in design/SOUNDS.md. files: finished recordings in public/audio/, one per take; empty means the synth placeholder plays. volume 0 to 1. jitter: random playback rate change, plus or minus. maxVoices: copies of this sound playing at once; a new one steals the oldest. refDistance and maxDistance in metres for spatial sounds.

B06-fire._note: GAME-09d (Paul): one mega dart, heavier than B04-fire: same shape, lower and longer.

B06-spin._note: GAME-09d (Paul): the Standard's motor at speed, deeper than B04-rev-loop. Placeholder: game-sounds.ts loops only B04-rev-loop today; wiring B06's loop belongs to the review (see HANDOFF).

B06-reload._note: GAME-09d (Paul): the drum box out and in, used by the B06 reload cues.

B05-fire._note: GAME-09e (Paul): one precision dart, a sharp crack: higher and shorter than B06-fire (SOUNDS.md 2.6).

B05-bolt._note: GAME-09e (Paul): the bolt worked between shots (the card's id; SOUNDS.md 2.6 splits it into bolt-back and bolt-fwd for the recording pass).

B05-reload._note: GAME-09e (Paul): the thin box magazine out and in, used by the B05 reload cues (SOUNDS.md 2.6 splits it into mag-out and mag-in).

B05-whistle._note: GAME-09e (Paul): the precision dart in flight (a whistler), capped to a few voices at once. Placeholder: nothing plays it yet, game-sounds.ts has no per-dart loop; wiring it belongs to the review (as with B06-spin).

FX-explode._note: GAME-09d (Paul): the shared explosion: a foam pop with a puff (SOUNDS.md EX-small's shape, the card's id).

SH-saw._note: GAME-04c: the foam saw grinding, a loop while a thrown disc lodges. Placeholder synth: a buzzy sawtooth with a slow wobble, the page pitches it by the spin.

F06-hum._note: GAME-10c: the Floater's float, a soft wobbling drone under it while its fins hold it up. Placeholder synth: two low triangles with a slow wobble (design/SOUNDS.md).

F06-spit._note: GAME-10c: the jaw snapping shut to spit a fan of blobs (or the one big blob). Placeholder synth: a wetter, lower cousin of F02-throw.

F06-blobBounce._note: GAME-10c: a small blob off a wall, a short foam tick before its last bounce. Placeholder synth: a quick filtered blip.

F07-crouch._note: GAME-10f: the Brawler folds before its leap, the telegraph. Placeholder synth: a low foam creak going down, then a small compressive thump as the legs load.

F07-punch._note: GAME-10f: the Brawler's two-fist punch. Placeholder synth: a heavy whoosh into a flat foam smack.

F07-swing._note: GAME-10i: the Brawler's sword swing. Placeholder synth: a broad whoosh off the foam blade, brighter and longer than the punch's thwack. Foley plus Blaster will replace it (design/SOUNDS.md).

F07-sword-break._note: GAME-10i: the Brawler's foam sword chipping away. Placeholder synth: a bright snap with falling crumbs over the generic part-thump. Foley plus Blaster will replace it (design/SOUNDS.md).

F07-land._note: GAME-10f: the Brawler lands and the shockwave starts. Placeholder synth: a heavy drop on foam, a low boom with a long tail.

F09-spinup._note: GAME-10g: the Crawler's barrels spinning up before the stream. Placeholder synth: a rising ratchet (Foley plus Blaster will replace it).

F09-pellet._note: GAME-10g: one pellet leaving the barrels. Cheap and quick; maxVoices is what keeps a storm of them in check (the card: many voices capped).

F09-step._note: GAME-10g: the Crawler's heavy foot plant (leg clicks, Foley later). Heavier than FX-step-medium.

F08-windup._note: GAME-10h: the Trawler lifts both launchers before the wall. Placeholder synth: a heavy wind with a rising clunk (Foley plus Blaster will replace it).

F08-wall._note: GAME-10h: one wall leaving the launchers. One sound per wall, not per ball (the card). Placeholder synth: a wide low thump with a hiss of foam.

F08-step._note: GAME-10h: the Trawler's heavy foot plant. The heaviest step in the game (health 80, speed 0.9): longer and lower than F09-step.

F10-jet._note: GAME-10j: the Turbo's jet hiss under it while its jets hold it up. Placeholder synth: a looping hiss of filtered noise with a small whistling tone under it (the F06-hum's pattern, airy instead of round, design/SOUNDS.md).

F10-shot._note: GAME-10j: the homing ball leaving the wrist launcher. Placeholder synth: a soft puff and a small rising ring (one per shot; maxVoices is the cap).

F10-fall._note: GAME-10j: the Turbo dropping to the floor when the last jet breaks. Placeholder synth: a soft heavy flop of foam, one, when the jet hiss stops.

F11-swing._note: GAME-10k: the Seawall's mace swing (the overhead and the sweep). Placeholder synth: a heavy wooden whoosh, deeper than the Roamer's club. Foley plus Blaster will replace it (design/SOUNDS.md).

F11-windup._note: GAME-10k: the Seawall's finisher: the slow high wind-up the player must hear to time the parry. Placeholder synth: a long low rising creak. Foley will replace it (design/SOUNDS.md).

F11-shield-break._note: GAME-10k: the Seawall's tower shield breaking off after its parries. Placeholder synth: a hard crack and a board falling apart over the generic part-thump. Foley will replace it (design/SOUNDS.md).
